title: Tree Hover Action
description: A FlatLaf JTree with hover action icons on each row, inline rename editing, and drag-and-drop reordering.

title: Skeleton
description: A JLayer LayerUI that shows shimmering loading placeholders shaped from the real components, and blocks input while loading.

title: Badge Notification
description: An animated notification badge that decorates any component through a JLayer, with counts, text or dots, any corner, and an alert animation.
